tagline: Room to Grow on a Quiet Street
description: A 5-bedroom, 3-bath, 2,631-square-foot home built in 2020 with block construction on one of the largest homesites in Promenade Estates, Sarasota: a 146-foot-deep lot at the quiet end of the street beside the cul-de-sac, with a 60-plus-foot driveway, two-car garage, front porch and a large fenced backyard. Upstairs, a loft and a bonus room give everyone a place to land. Flood zone X, HOA $268.25 per month, no CDD.

features.title: The Driveway Everyone Wants
features.text: Over 60 feet of driveway plus a two-car garage: parking for visiting grandparents, room for bikes and scooters, and plenty of runway for sidewalk-chalk masterpieces.

features.title: A Backyard with Real Depth
features.text: A 146-foot-deep homesite, one of the largest in the community, with a covered lanai and a big fenced backyard. Swing set, soccer goal and the dog can all fit at once.

features.title: The Quiet End of the Street
features.text: Set beside the cul-de-sac and away from Bay Street, so the block stays calm. It is the kind of street where kids learn to ride a bike.

features.title: Room for Everyone
features.text: Five bedrooms and three full baths across more than 2,600 square feet, plus a loft and a bonus room upstairs for a playroom, homework hub, home office or movie night.

features.title: Open Kitchen, Big Island
features.text: Granite counters, stainless appliances and a large island with seating open straight to the family room and dining area, so dinner prep and homework happen in the same place.

features.title: Built 2020, Built Solid
features.text: Concrete block construction, finished in 2020, on a homesite outside the flood zone (zone X). The roof and major systems are only about six years old, which means more weekends at the pool and fewer on projects.

callout.title: Make It Home by New Year’s
callout.text: Florida voters approved Amendment 3 on November 3, 2026. Starting January 1, 2027, the homestead exemption on non-school property taxes rises to $150,000, then to $250,000 in 2028, up from about $51,000 today.
bullets: Florida homestead status is set by who owns and lives in the home on January 1. Close and move in by December 31, then apply with the Property Appraiser by March 1, 2027.
Relocating from out of state? Owners who were not permanent Florida residents as of December 31, 2026 start at the current exemption and step up to the larger one in their fifth year.
School taxes, the Save Our Homes cap and portability are unchanged. Second homes and rentals don’t qualify for the larger exemption.
callout.footnote: General information, not tax or legal advice. Confirm your eligibility and timing with the Sarasota County Property Appraiser or your tax advisor.

lifestyle.title: Saturdays, Sorted
lifestyle.intro: Life here starts at the end of the driveway: a quiet cul-de-sac out front, resort-style amenities inside the community and Evie’s at Spanish Point a family bike ride away. No CDD, just a $268.25 monthly HOA.

items.title: Cul-de-Sac Living
items.text: Chalk art, scooter laps and neighbors who wave. The cul-de-sac out front is the block’s favorite playground.

items.title: Bike to Evie’s
items.text: Pedal over to Evie’s at Spanish Point for a waterfront lunch, cornhole on the lawn and Little Sarasota Bay views.

items.title: Splash Park
items.text: Sprayers, sunshine and squeals. Bring a towel and a spare outfit.

items.title: Resort-Style Pool
items.text: Big community pool with lap lanes, loungers and shade for the grown-ups.

items.title: Tot Playground
items.text: Slides and climbers sized for the littlest residents.

items.title: Hoops & Sand Volleyball
items.text: Basketball and volleyball courts for pickup games and family rivalries.

items.title: Dog Park
items.text: Separate big-dog and small-dog areas, so everyone gets zoomies on their own terms.

items.title: Fitness Center
items.text: A full gym in the clubhouse. Nap time just became workout time.

nearby.place: Evie’s at Spanish Point, by bike

schools.title: The School Run
schools.note: School bus routes are available. Zoning can change from year to year, so confirm current assignments with Sarasota County Schools.

cta.form_title: Bring the Kids. Bring Your Questions.
cta.form_intro: Tell us when you’d like to tour or what you want to know. Ryan or Alex will get right back to you, usually within a few hours.
cta.success_text: Your note about 5654 Woodland Sage Dr is on its way to Ryan and Alex. One of us will reach out personally, usually within a few hours.

faq.q: How large is 5654 Woodland Sage Dr?
faq.a: The home has 2,631 heated square feet with 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a loft, a bonus room and a 2-car garage, on a 146-foot-deep homesite in Promenade Estates, Sarasota, FL 34238. It was built in 2020 with concrete block construction.

faq.q: What is the HOA fee, and is there a CDD?
faq.a: The HOA is $268.25 per month and there are no CDD fees. Community amenities include a pool, splash park, tot playground, basketball and sand volleyball courts, a fitness center and a dog park with separate small- and large-dog areas.

faq.q: Does the home have a private pool?
faq.a: No. The home does not have a private pool; residents use the Promenade Estates community pool and splash park.

faq.q: Which schools serve 5654 Woodland Sage Dr?
faq.a: The home is zoned for Laurel Nokomis School (K-8) and Venice High School, with bus routes available. Pine View School, a gifted program with eligibility-based admission, is about 3 miles away. Confirm current zoning with Sarasota County Schools.

faq.q: How does Florida's Amendment 3 affect a buyer in 2027?
faq.a: Amendment 3, approved November 3, 2026, raises the homestead exemption on non-school property taxes to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028. Homestead status is based on ownership and permanent residence on January 1, with applications due March 1. Owners who were not permanent Florida residents on December 31, 2026 receive the current exemption until their fifth year of exemption.
